title: KR bluestem vs native little bluestem — crew-specific field ID and look-alikes
reason: Two existing canonical species and both existing genera were updated together. A botanical morphology comparison of long terminal KR racemes versus separate shorter little bluestem branch racemes is supported by local UT Austin and Texas A&M; unreliable node-hair-only cue corrected. Four original photos pixel-inspected; 3 source-credited public panel candidates, six accurate visible-structure arrows and practical look-alikes.

qa.source_disagreement_guardrail: Texas A&M calls KR nodes glabrous while UT North Hays/Williamson reports short hairs; no false hairless-only rule
true_diagnostic_gaps: KR whole rooted flowering plant and leaf-collar papilla hair macro
Little bluestem short fuzzy axillary raceme at high resolution
Both species mature sessile/pedicelled spikelet pairs with ruler

publication_policy: Use only existing rights-filtered noncommercial GitHub Pages QA workflow. One marker for both species, no Google Sheets or automation changes. Confirm completed build+deployment on this commit before claiming live.
